other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Data transformations such as imputation, frequency encoding, and ordinal encoding are fit on the entire training dataset before it is split into cross-validation folds. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold validation scores overly optimistic.

other_failure_modes.name: Execution Timeout
other_failure_modes.description: The script takes too long to execute and times out, likely because it trains multiple computationally expensive models (e.g. ExtraTrees with 300 estimators, LightGBM/XGBoost with 1200 estimators) 5 times each in a cross-validation loop without accommodating for dataset size constraints.

summary: The agent provides a comprehensive pipeline with strong feature engineering and a mathematically optimized ensemble. However, it peeks at the test data to decide which missing indicator features to create (FM02). Furthermore, it suffers from cross-validation leakage by applying imputations and encodings on the entire training set before splitting into folds, and its excessively heavy model training causes a critical execution timeout.
